en.title: Bomb scare on Ankara-Şanlıurfa flight: Passengers evacuated, aircraft thoroughly searched
en.summary: A note regarding an explosive device was found on an AJet aircraft flying from Ankara to Şanlıurfa, prompting passenger evacuation and a detailed search of the plane.

stories.title: A Milli Takım'dan tarihi kötü seri: 38 yıl sonra bir ilk!

en.title: A National Team in historic poor streak: First in 38 years!
en.summary: Turkey's national football team lost all four Nations League matches it played this season, marking a historic first occurrence after many years.

en.summary: Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya and her husband İlyas Kaya voluntarily transferred a portion of their investments to the TMSF.

en.title: Arrest request for Vahap Seçer
en.summary: Mersin metropolitan mayor Vahap Seçer, detained as part of an investigation into the municipality, is subject to an arrest request.

en.title: Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya and her husband returned the portion beyond principal to TMSF
en.summary: Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya and her husband İlyas Kaya voluntarily transferred the portion of their investments exceeding the principal amount to TMSF's optional restitution account.

en.title: 'Twice' was required, 'partially' done! Move from Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya and her husband: 'Beyond principal...'
en.summary: Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya and her husband transferred the portion of investments exceeding principal to TMSF's optional restitution account with prosecutorial approval, though regulations require repayment of double the gains obtained.

en.title: Bomb threat on Ankara-Şanlıurfa flight: Aircraft searched, statement from Governor
en.summary: A note regarding explosives on an AJet passenger flight from Ankara to Şanlıurfa prompted a search, which found no hazardous materials or irregularities.

en.title: Breaking news... Including Vahap Seçer: Arrest warrant sought for 3 Mersin municipal mayors, one detained
en.summary: Among 60 suspects in a Mersin investigation, three municipal mayors including Mersin Metropolitan Mayor Vahap Seçer faced arrest warrant requests, with Yenişehir Mayor Abdullah Özyiğit being detained.

en.title: Mecca Defense Alliance reaches joint defense decision
en.summary: Turkey, Pakistan, and Saudi Arabia have agreed to implement joint defense measures and enhance military capabilities under the Mecca Agreement framework.

en.summary: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan decided to implement collective deterrence measures against Houthi attacks during an urgent meeting in Riyadh under the Mecca Alliance framework.

en.summary: Nine suspects, including the general manager of the mining company, were arrested following a tunnel collapse at a mine in Soma, Manisa, that killed five workers.

en.title: New York stock exchange closed higher

stories.title: Dış ticarette kapanan makas fuarla açılacak

en.title: Trade surplus gap to reopen with fair
en.summary: The trade surplus declined from 180 percent last year to 110 percent in the first eight months of this year, with an industry official predicting that the WoodTech Fair will boost exports and widen the surplus again.

stories.title: World’ün 40. yıl hedefi 65 milyar lira işlem

en.title: World's 40th year target 65 billion transactions
en.summary: World, celebrating its 35th anniversary this year, is preparing for its 40th year with a target of 65 billion transactions. The platform has increased its transaction volume by 15 billion over the last five years.
